CREATE VIEW gold.calendar
AS SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://datalakeadventureworks1.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Calendar',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS Query1
